name: nonprofit
title: Nonprofit base
description: The work every nonprofit does around its programmes, as recipes over its own files: funder and donor relations (one file per funder, a verbatim log of every figure sent, talking points, open calls), grant reporting checked against that log, meeting notes into dated journals, communications in the organization's voice with a story bank where every line carries its fact, an events and editorial calendar, and a programme or cohort run from its handbook.
suits: A nonprofit or a funder of any size that raises money, reports to funders, meets partners, communicates, and runs a programme (an accelerator, a fellowship, a cohort). Two people or two hundred; the files are the same.

fundersPath.description: One file per funder, donor or prospect that funds this organization, plus TALKING-POINTS.md.

participantsPath.description: One file per organization or person a programme serves (grantees, cohort members, portfolio organizations), each with its journal.

programmePath.description: The programme the organization runs (an accelerator, a fellowship): its handbook, its cohorts, its sessions.

eventsPath.description: One file per event the organization watches, attends or speaks at.

newsletterPath.description: The newsletters: one folder per newsletter, with its format and its issues.

storyBankPath.description: The story bank: formulations and anecdotes ready to reuse, each with the fact behind it.

editorialCalendarPath.description: The editorial calendar: one row per planned piece.

extractedFrom: Distilled on 2026-10-29 from the recipes a nonprofit running this kit has used for a year (funder reporting, a relationship journal, meeting recaps, messages, a story bank, an events base, a fact bank), written generic: every example is invented.
